newsitem.title: USA: United Tech earnings rise 21 percent.
newsitem.headline: United Tech earnings rise 21 percent.

text.p: United Technologies Corp. said Wednesday its earnings rose 21 percent in the third quarter, fuelled by strength at its Pratt & Whitney jet engine unit and improved results in flight systems and automotive businesses.

UTC, which also makes Otis elevators and Carrier air conditioners, said net income increased to $254 million, or $1.94 a share, for the quarter, from $210 million, or $1.60 a share, in the 1995 quarter.
Wall Street had been expecting earnings of $1.87 a share, according to First Call, which tracks forecasts. The per share figures do not reflect a stock split announced on Sept. 30.
UTC said sales grew 5 percent to $5.94 billion from $5.65 billion.
The company's stock edged lower, off 50 cents at $124.875, in morning trading on the New York Stock Exchange.
Pratt & Whitney's operating earnings jumped 25 percent on higher service revenue, cost-cutting and improved productivity, the Hartford, Conn.-based company said.
Profits grew 28 percent in flight systems, which includes Sikorsky helicopters and Hamilton Standard electronic controls, and 20 percent in its automotive components business.
Earnings at Carrier grew 10 percent as strong air conditioner sales to consumers and businesses offset weakness in its transport refrigeration business.
Otis elevator's operating profit rose 2 percent. Excluding foreign currency translations and charges to cut staff in Europe, income rose 10 percent in the quarter.
